channel.title: Joe — Urgent / Exploited
channel.description: Critical vulnerabilities, active exploitation, ransomware, and emergency patching.

item.title: 🔴 CVE-2026-102858 Microsoft Office OneNote Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.
Microsoft is announcing the availability of the security updates for Microsoft Office for Mac. Customers running affected Mac software should install the update for their product to be protected from this vulnerability. Customers running other Microsoft Office software do not need to take any action. See the [Release Notes](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=831049) for more information and download links.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 20h

item.title: 🔴 CISA Urges Immediate Ivanti Connect Secure Updates as Honeypots Log 105 Exploit Attempts
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday urged organizations to take steps to immediately update their Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) appliances and deployments to the latest version following the disclosure of an actively exploited vulnerability. The security flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-104935 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of authentication bypass impacting ICS

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1d
